fusions.name: Gnawed Joists
fusions.desc: Your swarm gnaws through the supports overhead and brings them down, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Dogpile Flat
fusions.desc: Your swarm piles onto one enemy, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Flat Under the Blow
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Weak Point Chewed
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
